selection_rule: Highest development macro-F1; test excluded from selection

provenance.citation: Casanueva et al. (2020), Efficient Intent Detection with Dual Sentence Encoders
provenance.scope: 12 selected complaint-related intents out of the original 77; English only
provenance.split_policy: Official test preserved; stratified 15% validation from the cleaned official training pool
limitations: Intent labels describe the reported problem, not a verified operational root cause.
Authored demo inbox and investigation playbooks are separate from the benchmark.
A score on this selected subset is not a score on all 77 intents.

implementation: Own TF-IDF, softmax regression, Adam and macro-F1. NumPy arrays and SciPy sparse storage only.
root_cause_evaluation: Not measured: BANKING77 has intent labels and no verified root-cause labels.
llm_evaluation: Local LLM is used for grounded explanation, not for the reported classification scores.
